title: Soil Types in Haryana
what_it_supports: Haryana has multiple soil groups; Rewari is listed among districts with hills and rock outcrops.
limitations: Not a crop-specific pH or soil-texture suitability range.
next_action: Find district/block-level soil information applicable to the farm.

title: Haryana agricultural profile
what_it_supports: Soil salinity and alkalinity are important agricultural constraints in Haryana.
limitations: Does not provide universal crop-specific pH or texture ranges.
next_action: Locate crop-specific guidance for salt-affected soils.

title: Farm Advisory Service
what_it_supports: Identifies the university's farm advisory and KVK network.
limitations: Directory page, not a crop-specific soil recommendation.
next_action: Seek current soil guidance from the relevant KVK or CCS HAU Bawal research station.

title: Characterizing Vertical Nutrient Heterogeneity and Soil Property Interactions in Agricultural Soils
what_it_supports: The study reports neutral-to-alkaline soils and textures ranging from sandy loam to sandy clay loam at its sampled experimental sites.
limitations: Site observations are not universal crop suitability limits.
next_action: Inspect methods, sampling locations and full text before using any result.

title: Effect of Dominant Cropping Systems on the Soil Properties in Sirsa District, Haryana
publisher: Journal of Soil Salinity and Water Quality
what_it_supports: Describes measurement of soil properties across cropping systems in Sirsa.
limitations: Sirsa results cannot automatically be applied to Rewari or interpreted as crop-specific suitability limits.
next_action: Review the full study and identify whether any result is relevant beyond its sampled sites.

title: Effect of conservation tillage on C and N fractions in soils having different textures under rice-wheat cropping system in Haryana
publisher: Journal of Soil and Water Conservation
what_it_supports: Examines sandy loam, clay loam and loamy soils in a Haryana rice-wheat context.
limitations: Focuses on tillage and soil carbon/nitrogen, not a universal soil suitability range.
next_action: Inspect the study for relevant site-specific findings and avoid inferring pH thresholds.

title: Package of Practices for Rabi and Kharif Crops
what_it_supports: HAU identifies official seasonal Package of Practices publications as agricultural extension resources.
limitations: This directory does not itself establish crop-specific soil pH or texture values; the relevant publication and edition must be inspected.
next_action: Obtain the current Rabi and Kharif editions and record the exact crop section and page for any soil guidance.

title: CCS HAU Farm Advisory Service — KVK Bawal
what_it_supports: HAU lists the KVK Bawal helpline as 18001804002 for agricultural advisory services.
limitations: A contact listing is not itself an agronomic recommendation.
next_action: Ask for current crop-specific soil pH and texture recommendations for the relevant Rewari farming area.

title: Package of Practices for Rabi Crops
what_it_supports: Wheat: well-drained medium loam is described as suitable; saline, alkaline and waterlogged soils are discouraged. Chickpea: well-drained loamy-sandy and light soils; the edition states not to sow where pH exceeds 8.5 or EC exceeds 0.8 dS/m. Findings from the extracted Rabi PDF.
limitations: Older edition, publication context 2014-2015. The chickpea pH value is an avoidance threshold, not an optimal range. Confirm edition, page references and current applicability before production use.
next_action: Verify the printed page and edition details; compare with the latest HAU recommendation before creating any rule.

title: Package of Practices for Kharif Crops
what_it_supports: The rice section describes medium-textured soil as more suitable for the direct-seeded Basmati system discussed.
limitations: 2016 edition. The rice statement is method-specific and must not be generalized to all rice systems. A general maize soil pH or texture threshold has not been established.
next_action: Verify the printed page and relevant maize section; obtain a current edition before creating rules.
